description: This file defines the DrupalElementStyleUi class, a CKEditor 5 plugin that manages UI components such as buttons and dropdowns for styling elements within the editor, including creation and update logic.

classes.name: DrupalElementStyleUi
classes.description: A CKEditor 5 plugin class that provides UI controls (buttons and dropdowns) for applying Drupal-specific element styles within the editor.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, creating buttons and dropdowns based on configuration and available styles.

methods.name: updateOptionVisibility
methods.description: Updates the visibility of style options depending on the current selection's media type.

methods.name: _createDropdown
methods.description: Creates a dropdown UI component for style selection and registers it in the component factory.

methods.name: _createListDropdown
methods.description: Creates a list dropdown component for style options.

methods.name: _createButton
methods.description: Creates a toggle button for a specific style and registers it.

methods.name: getDropdownListItemDefinitions
methods.description: Generates list item definitions for dropdown menus based on styles.

methods.name: _executeCommand
methods.description: Executes the style application command with specified style name and group.
